tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ḍāk+ki'i rkyang sgrub bzhugs pa lags pas gzigs mdzod:

EMBED Photoshop.Image.7 \s bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor pa las dang skal bar ldan pa'i bus: mkha' 'gro ma lus dang grib ma bzhin du bsgrub par bya ste: de yang rnal 'byor gsum ldan gyi sgo nas nyams su blang : rgya rgya rgya: de la dang po lha'i rnal 'byor dang : gnyis pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang : gsum pa rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor ro: dang po lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed: bla ma spyi bor bsgoms la gsol ba dung ba cig gdab: de nas rang skad cig gis stong pa nyid du bsgom: stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje phag mo bsgom ste: sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: khro zhal dmar mo spyan gsum ma: spyi gtsug na phag zhal mthing kha ngur ba g.yas su lta ba: ral ba kham nag thur la 'phyang ba: phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams pa: g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thogs pa: kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung g.yon du bcug pa: rus pa'i rgyan drug dang me long dang dril bu'i sgra 'khrol ba: zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i brla la: g.yas bskum pa'i mthe bong gtad pa: me ri 'bar ba'i klong na ro'i gdan la phyed skyil du bzhugs par bsam mo: de'i spyi gtsug tu rdo rje ḍāk+ki ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa: g.yon khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa: rdo rje rgya gram dang ro'i gdan la brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa: rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa ha las bskyed: mgrin par rat+na ḍāk+ki sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas rin chen bsnams pa: g.yon thod pa bsnams pa: zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa: rat+na dang ro'i gdan la ri las bskyed: thugs khar pad+ma ḍak+ki dmar mo g.yas pad+ma g.yon thod pa bsnams pa: zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa: pad+ma dang ro'i gdan la ni las bskyed do: lte bar las kyi ḍāk+ki ljang gu:

phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon thod pa bsnams pa: zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa: ral gri dang ro'i gdan la sa las bskyed do: lha'i de kho na nyid kyi don yang lha rdo rje phag mo de: phyi ltar na: yum pha rol du phyin ma: nang ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gsang ba ltar na yum e ka tsa ti yin no: mkha' 'gro ma bzhi yang phyi ltar na 'byung ba bzhi: nang ltar na lha mo bzhi: gsang ba ltar na yi ge bzhi'i ngo bo yin no: ༈ gnyis pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni: ma ha ri ni sa: zhes pa mkha' 'gro lnga yi snying po yin no: zhag bdun bzlas pas mkha' 'gro mas dngos su byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro: sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi don yang snying pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su yi ge lnga'i tshul du yod pa las: dbus su ma dmar po srog gi dngas mar gnas so: shar phyogs chu yi rtsa 'dab dkar po la ha dkar po: lho phyogs sa'i rtsa 'dab ser po la ri ser po: nub phyogs me'i rtsa 'dab dmar po la ni dmar po: byang phyogs rlung gi rtsa 'dab ljang gu la sa ljang gu gnas so: yi ge 'bru lnga po ḍāk+ki lnga'i srog gi sa bon yin pas ḍāk+ki ma rnams kyang sngags kyi sgra di ri ri sgrog cing : snying mi 'khor bar yi ge rnams 'khor bar bsam mo: rtags ni: bdag gi shes pa 'gyur ba dang : 'phar ba dang : ldeg pa dang : 'khrab pa dang : glu len gar byed pa dang sems bde bar shar nas 'khrab snying 'dod pa rnams 'byung ngo : de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi thun 'jog tsa na 'khor 'phro bcad pas nyams bde lhan gyis 'gro: ༈ gsum pa rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor ni: ḍāk+ki ma lnga po de yang : phyi ltar na sku lnga: nang ltar na ḍāk+ki lnga: gsang ba ltar na yi ge lnga'o: rdzogs rim gyi de kho na nyid kyi don yang : phyi ltar na: sangs rgyas ḍāk+ki chos kyi sku: rdo rje ḍāk+ki longs sku: rin chen ḍāk+ki sprul sku: pad+ma ḍāk+ki ngo bo nyid kyi sku:

las kyi ḍāk+ki mngon par byang chub pa'i sku'o: nang ltar na: sangs rgyas ḍāk+ki gti mug rnam par dag: rdo rje ḍāk+ki zhe sdang rnam par dag: rin chen ḍāk+ki nga rgyal rnam par dag: pad+ma ḍāk+ki 'dod chags rnam par dag: las kyi ḍāk+ki phrag dog rnam par dag pa'o: gsang ba ltar na ye shes lnga ste: sangs rgyas ḍāk+ki chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes: rdo rje ḍāk+ki me long lta bu'i ye shes: rin chen ḍāk+ki mnyam nyid ye shes: pad+ma ḍāk+ki sor rtogs ye shes: las kyi ḍāk+ki bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so: de ltar ḍāk+ki lnga bsgoms nas: sngags yig 'bru lnga bzlas pas: ḍāk+ki ma dngos su 'grub nas sku lnga lhun gyis grub: dug lnga gnas su dag: ye shes lnga rang bzhin gyis 'char: 'gro ba rnams su rang bzhin gyi skye ba'i rgyun chad: skye shi la nyam mi nga ba 'byung ngo : lta ba sangs rgyas ḍāk+ki ste: cir yang ma grub rang bzhin yin: sgom pa rdo rje ḍāk+ki ste: mi 'gyur mi shigs sgom dang bral: spyod pa rin chen ḍāk+ki ste: kun dang mthun par rang byung shar: 'bras bu pad+ma ḍāk+ki ste: 'khor ba ma spangs rang sar grol: dam tshig las kyi ḍāk+ki ste: 'gro don thabs mkhas phrin las mdzad: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas la: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lung bstan thob: mkhar chen bza' la byin brlabs zhugs: mkha' 'gros lung bstan gnang ba thob: tsit+ta thugs kyi dkyil du sbos: las can cig 'phrad par shog: ḍāk+ki thod rgal du bsgrub pa rdzogs so: ༄༅: :mkha' 'gro ma'i srog gi snying po: ha ri ni sa ḍāk+ki bzhi dbang du sdud pa'i snying po yin pas rtogs pa rgyud la skyer ma btub na rdo rje ḍāk+ki dbang du ma 'dus pa yin pas bdud rtsi lnga la longs spyod: gcer bu bya: smyo spyod bya: snang ba dkrug go: ha ri ni sa badz+ra ḍāk+ki ni hūm̐ dza: zhes bzlas shing dbang du bsdu'o: rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skyer yong ngo :

des lta ba phyogs med rang sar grol: zas nor gyi bsod nams 'phel du ma btub na rin chen ḍāk+ki dbang du ma 'dus pa yin pas: me tshogs dang : gos tshogs bya: chags zhen bcad: nor zas g.yang nyams pa zlog: ha ri ni sa: rat+na ḍāk+ki ni hūṃ dza: zhes bzlas shing dbang du bsdu'o: bsod nams khyad par can skye'o: des zas nor gter rdol ba ltar 'bul du 'ong ngo : lus la drod mi skye zhing bud med mi 'du snang ba'i dngos po la chags zhen che na pad+ma ḍāk+ki dbang du ma 'dus pa yin pas: dka' thub bya: gtum mo sbar: gos gdab: ri khrod 'grim: bdud rtsi za: ha ri ni sa pad+ma ḍāk+ki ni hūṃ dza: zhes bzlas shing dbang du bsdu'o: lus la drod skye: bud med kun gyi yid 'phrog: snang ba'i dngos po la chags zhen mi skye'o: rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char du ma btub na: las kyi ḍāk+ki dbang du ma 'dus pa yin pas: rig pa bcun: dka' thub bya: snang ba dkrug: rten 'brel brtsi: ri khrod 'grim: mchod bshags bya: ha ri ni sa: karma ḍāk+ki ni hūm̐ dza: zhes bzlas shing dbang du bsdu'o: rig pa dngas shing rten 'brel sna tshogs pa 'char: yid la gang bsam pa 'grub: dgra bgegs gnyis ka thul lo: snang ba dbang du ma 'dus par: 'du ba gang yang med na: 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma dbang du ma 'dus pa yin pas: ri khrod 'grim: zas tshogs bya: sbyin bsreg bya: gtor chogs bya: lcags brdab: zhe 'dod med pa'i sgo nas ci byung yang phaṭa kyis brdab: me tshogs bya: phye mar dang rin chen bsreg: ha ri ni sa 'gul 'gul: ma ma hring hring : ma ma kha shi: mi snying sgul sgul: mi 'gram chog chog: hring hring sdus sdus: ma ma kha shi baṃ swāhā: mi nor zas gsum dbang du sdus: zhes bzlas so: khrom 'du: mi 'du: nor 'du: zas 'du'o: ḍāk+ki ma'i bka' chad byung nas na tsha drag po byung ba'am: ci byas cir mi btub cing : shes pa 'khrul na: gtor tshogs bya:

gtun bu chag thang zhig khur la: phyogs bzhir phar 'gro tshur 'gro gom pa bcu tsam re bya: de nas phyir bor bas bka' chad bor bar bsam mo: rde'u bcu gcig bsdus la: rang la bskor ba phyogs rer gom pa bcu tsam re bor la lhag ma dor la bar chad dor bar bsam mo: ha ri ni sa: bu tsa swa bhā ba ad+ma ko3haṃ: zhes bzlas so: lus bla ma yi dam ḍāk+ki gsum la tshogs su 'bul lo: bka' chad dang dam tshig nyams pa thams cad sangs dag nas song bar bsam mo: rang gi sems gsal stong du bzhag go: mkha' 'gro ma'i gnad yig rten 'brel: gdams pa khyad par 'phags pa: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gyi don du mdzad pa rdzogs so: las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: dge'o: : mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)ḍāk+ki'i rkyang sgrub/ - PAGE 90 -- PAGE 91 -- PAGE 86 -
